name: Tenjou Miu
source:
A mysterious girl that suddenly appeared before [url=https://vndb.org/c20897]Yukiha[/url] and claims to be his daughter.

Declaring that she came from the future to make him happy, she puts her various skills to good use. Though she acts tough, she is still as emotional as any little girl.

[From [url=https://fragmentsnote-plus.ullucus.com/en/]Switch Site[/url]]
